messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Billing telemetry anomaly detected — token_count stream variance > 6sigma on emitter-3 for the past 6m. Auto-escalating to on-call.
alice.nguyen: oncall here. seeing a spike in counted tokens vs ingest logs. customers getting overage flags.
ben.kim: copying metrics: `sum(token_count) by emitter` looks like emitter-3 doubled for certain windows. might be duped ACKs from the proxy.
carla.sr: any customer-visible alerts? pm-anna: yes, Ops reported 14 customer overage flags in the last 20m, mostly small accounts. we should assess damage and hold billing if needed.
alice.nguyen: agreed. @billing-sre can you pause downstream billing-promote job for emitter-3 windows?
billing-sre: initiating pause on `billing-apply` for stream emitter-3. will hold new charge events for 10m and retry reconcile.
infra-luke: quick check — the emitter consumer had a recent deploy 30m ago (rollback candidate). rolling back consumer instance group now.
ben.kim: quick query I ran: ```sql
-- candidates for duplicate emission
select emitted_at, count(*) as cnt, emitter_id from token_events
where emitted_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
group by emitted_at, emitter_id
having cnt > 1
order by cnt desc
limit 20;
```
carla.sr: nice. I also see delayed usage reports (ingest lag) for ingest-proxy-eu2 between 17:03-17:10 which could explain late dedupe.
alice.nguyen: triage steps: 1) pause billing apply (done) 2) roll back emitter consumer (in progress) 3) run dedupe script and reconcile window 4) inform affected customers with temporary credit.
pm-anna: I'll draft a short customer note and queue it for review. assume 15-30m for initial update.
billing-sre: dedupe job kicked: `scripts/dedupe_tokens --stream emitter-3 --since 30m` — reporting progress. first pass shows ~1.9x duplicate factor on a subset.
ben.kim: looks like duplicates are from replays where sequence_id wasn't persisted due to transient DB timeout. patch incoming to add idempotency guard.
alice.nguyen: thanks. setting incident state -> investigating. severity P2 because billing impact but throttled and paused.
carla.sr: note for postmortem: check emitter ack handling, idempotency, and alert thresholds (6sigma maybe too tight?).
pm-anna: customer note ready draft: "We observed transient duplicate token counts causing incorrect overage flags for a small number of customers. We paused billing while we reconcile and will credit any erroneous charges." pinging legal for approval. :pray:
alice.nguyen: good. once rollback finishes and dedupe completes, we'll resume billing-apply with a guard run. I'll update in 10m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1759012345 — status: investigating — assignees: alice.nguyen, ben.kim.
